payload.text: ST0011/02 (WP02b), THE LOOP, building on vc's approval (2026-10-31) of ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/st11-wp02b/DESIGN.md sections A to H, with seven rulings: (1) no ci.poll key, the poll RELEASE_POLL_SECONDS and the deadline ci.wait from the loop's start; (2) leg_start <leg> and leg_read <leg>, one <word><TAB><detail> line in ci-state's words, names and shapes agreed with dc before code, so WP05's and WP06's hook-ins are one line each (proposed to dc 2026-10-31: <leg> local, candidate, legs.<name>, macos; context in LEG_ROOT, LEG_PROJECT, LEG_SHA, LEG_REF; absent read at pre-flight, not waited for); (3) a stop's summary names each remote leg left to finish and where its seal lands, beside the killed local run and the deleted candidate; (4) A5 stands; (5) vc names the retired release publish verb in the sweep's message; (6) one unit unless a clean seam appears between the new shape and the retirements, then two stacked units, each critic-reviewed before its first run; (7) at the landing, AC-2.2 and AC-2.3's rows green, AT-2.2 and AT-2.4 green where WP02b completes them. Devbin's own ci.tag goes in this unit; its ci.wait is WP02c's. Built on main at bd13167f or later, in a new clone.
